data.one_liner: Java classes for testing Flutter apps using Espresso.
data.what_it_does: Provides bindings for Espresso tests of Flutter Android apps, allowing you to drive Flutter widgets from a native Android Espresso test using Java or Kotlin.
use_when: You need to drive Flutter widgets from native Android Espresso tests
You are integrating Flutter into an existing native Android app and need cross-boundary UI testing
avoid_when: You are writing pure Flutter applications where standard integration_test package is sufficient
You are testing on iOS (Espresso is Android-only)
strengths: Enables native Android Espresso tests to interact with Flutter widgets
Supports running tests locally via Gradle or on Firebase Test Lab
weaknesses: Requires complex native setup including Gradle dependencies, network security config, and Java/Kotlin test classes
data.setup_notes: Requires adding dev_dependency, modifying AndroidManifest.xml for network security config, configuring dependencies in android/app/build.gradle.kts, writing native Java/Kotlin Android instrumentation tests, and setting up a test driver script.
